actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +6, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _Failure:_ 18 (4d8) Cold damage. _Success:_ Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. _First Failure:_ The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. _Second Failure:_ The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
